title: IFC-CURSOR-OPERANDS: finite cursor-role emission with counted full-address dispatch

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N). Its total sequential charged work is O(n^(51/4)2^((7/6)sqrt n)), including classical bit arithmetic, uniform circuit and address generation, every gate, measurement, source copy, discarded attempt, initialization and cleanup. This exact envelope has growth index1/2. The guarantee holds on every branch, including erroneous-label, failure, abort and overflow branches, and jointly with all other claims for this one configuration. All hidden constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes.
